rows.grounds: compound of uraga (serpent) and āsana (seat), object of seated posture
nominal adjective describing Parama Bhairava; sandhi form of āsīnaḥ before following word
compound of yoga (yogic) and nidrā (sleep), state attained
verb expressing entry into the state of yogic sleep

items.question: Upon what seat and into what state did Parama Bhairava enter?
premises: Parama Bhairava was seated upon a serpent seat.
Parama Bhairava entered the state of yogic sleep.
This action continues the account of Parama Bhairava in the primordial ocean.
items.inference: Parama Bhairava assumed a seated posture on the serpent seat and entered yogic sleep.
items.plain_english: Seated on the serpent-seat, he entered yogic sleep.
